subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

 A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

 A − B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

 A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

 A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

 How is M related to Q if ‘M + N − O × P ÷ Q’?

Given: M + N − O × P ÷ Q

M + N → M is the mother of N.

N − O → N is the brother of O. 

O × P → O is the wife of P.

P ÷ Q → P is the father of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/330109dce9859a6e7b6616c2ab4e57f25845375b971dce81ad00f35cc5e67fe6.png] 

Thus, M is Q's maternal grandmother or mother's mother.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
